trigger: The matched-role Cosmos canonical batch reached the preregistered 90 C simulator-card stop threshold and was excluded in full.
purpose: Complete the local grid without weakening the 90 C safety stop or silently mixing different safety cadences.

guard.mechanism: docker pause/unpause of the named Isaac simulator container only
guard.event_log: One JSONL file per batch under artifacts/vla_wam_shared_v1/thermal_logs

scope: All definitive closed-loop batches executed after this amendment, for both checkpoints and both static and hierarchy grids.
matched_static_consequence: The previously completed Cosmos short-paraphrase batch is moved to supporting evidence and rerun from seed 6100 under this same active guard. The interrupted canonical batch remains excluded. Neither earlier batch enters prospective estimates.
invariants: The guard does not advance simulated time while paused.
Task, reset state, model, prompt, policy request seed, action horizon, camera configuration, and GPU roles remain frozen.
The 90 C emergency threshold still stops and excludes the entire batch.
Every pause, resume, peak sampled temperature, and cooldown duration is logged.
Policy-request latency remains the inference comparison; episode wall time includes any cooling pause and is reported with that limitation.
claim_boundary: A host pause can influence wall-clock-dependent realtime rendering. Exact byte-causal language claims therefore continue to come only from the fixed-observation probe; closed-loop task success remains the primary behavioral outcome.
